watch.summary: The streamer proudly celebrates watching his favorite esports team win after five years of supporting them.

beats.what: Streamer expresses satisfaction with the team he supports while watching Valorant gameplay.
He gets hyped as the team secures the round.
He reflects on five years of ups and downs as the pro players celebrate on screen.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Five years... ups and downs, but we up!
watch.why: This clip is a wholesome moment of loyal fan excitement rather than comedy. It works as fan hype for esports followers, but lacks a comedic setup or punchline.
